title: Show item stats in modal (mobile)
description: Mobile users can't hover for Wowhead tooltips — show item stats directly in the modal.

title: Paperdoll clicks should open item modal
description: Clicking an item icon in the paperdoll navigates to Wowhead instead of opening the item details modal.

title: Gem modal shows wrong quality color
description: All gems appear as epic (purple) regardless of actual quality.

title: 2H weapon tooltip not showing on hover
description: When selecting 2H spec, the 2H weapon slot doesn't show tooltips on hover.

title: Move profession filter higher on page
description: Profession filter is too far down — easy to miss. Should be above the gear list.

title: Dark mode improvements
description: Some text is hard to read in dark mode, especially muted labels.

title: Export gear list to text/image
description: Allow users to export their BiS list as a shareable image or text format for Discord.
